method.game_building: top surface > 2.5 m above the nearest open game ground (exterior ground or open-air floor seen from above); ground slabs, retaining walls, railings and glass canopies excluded; a storey with its roof within 1 m of the DTM and under 5 m above the sunken game ground counts as buried (game_buried_storey_m2)
method.verdicts: ok: IoU>=0.85 and worst side mean offset<=1.5 m; minor: IoU>=0.7 and <=3 m; generic: IoU<0.25 (not traced individually); otherwise off
method.sides: overhang: game outside OSM; shortfall: OSM not covered by game; depth is the 95th percentile distance from the OSM facade
method.shift: best translation (east, north) of the game footprint within +/-10 m
